reader_startup_gap.limit: Counts apply to the instrumented indexed regular-file reader. No syscall-level audit exists for incidental interpreter startup access, so this review does not certify that total private startup I/O used only the index or met the aggregate open cap.
reader_startup_gap.mitigation: No pre-existing history entries were observed: first history item was the initial reviewer command. All exit callbacks were cleared before interpreter exit; history was cleared only in memory, and bytecode writing was then disabled. No private output was intentionally written.
reader_startup_gap.observed: Reviewer launched ordinary system Python 3.9.6 as python3 -q -i, without -I -S -B; readline and rlcompleter loaded.
